QUOTE: Accumulates; no stated tier removes it ... Accumulates, same as tier 3 ... "you can correct our guesses; you cannot un-discover a fact."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says tiers 3 and 4 accumulate the same way, but it never says that the distinction between them is deliberately inert, and it doesn't name the fact-versus-guess line as what carries the weight.
